title: Nonnegative acceptance probability
statement: Let $T$ be a nonadaptive function tester with a finite seed space and a probability distribution on its seeds, and let $f$ be a function from its domain to its codomain. The probability that $T$ accepts the transcript obtained by querying $f$ is nonnegative.
